title: Voice commands and system usability
summary: Feedback about voice commands and related system operation is split between praise for easy satnav and working voice control, criticism of command reliability, and many fragments where "work" refers to unrelated contexts or sentiment is unclear.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise voice commands working well and describe the satnav and system voice as simple and pleasant to use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report that commands do not work well and cause problems in how the system responds.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments often use "work" in unrelated ways or mention setup, settings, profiles, and voice-command practicality without enough clear topic sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments use the word "work" to mean employment, travel to work, or general operation rather than clearly discussing voice commands.
Several undetermined examples mention system setup, driver profiles, or delayed voice responses, so the topic cluster mixes closely related usability issues with unrelated uses of the keyword.
Examples are insufficient to separate views on voice commands from broader infotainment usability in every fragment.
